projects.name: kanban-fork
projects.projectBlurb: Project: the vombor/kanban fork of cline/kanban, a TypeScript CLI + local web server (src/, tRPC runtime API, agent adapters, worktree and session management) with a React/Vite web UI (web-ui/) and an Electron shell (packages/desktop). It is a board for orchestrating coding agents (Cline CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot...) in per-card git worktrees. Base branch fork/stack = upstream main + the fork patches (fork.3: no embedded Cline SDK; runtime auto-review). Work in progress: folding the ~/.kanban dev-team kit into this repo (docs/fork/kit-merge-plan.md). Check with npm run check (lint, typecheck, runtime tests), npm run web:typecheck and npm run web:test. Keep upstream-shaped changes small and separate from fork-only ones, and never push.
projects.//toggles: 2026-10-06: user wants every card on this board to use the Kanban default agent (claude); the orchestrator reviews and lands. Autoland must not QA, rework or land here.
